jobs.description:
CordenPharma ist eine der führenden Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CDMO) und entwickelt und produziert im Auftrag ihrer Kunden als „Full-Service“-Dienstleister pharmazeutische Wirkstoffe, Arzneimittel und damit verbundene Verpackungsdienstleistungen. Die Gruppe beschäftigt rund 3.500 Mitarbeiter. Unser Netzwerk in Europa, Asien und den USA bietet flexible und spezialisierte Lösungen für sechs Technologieplattformen: Peptides, Lipids & Carbohydrates, Injectables, Highly Potent & Oncology, Small Molecules und Oligonucleotides. Wir streben nach Spitzenleistungen bei der Unterstützung dieses Netzwerks und engagieren uns für die Bereitstellung von Produkten höchster Qualität zum Wohle der Patienten. Our People Vision: We strive for excellence. We share our passion. Together, we make a difference in patients’ lives. Gruppenleiter Produktion (m/w/d) 2-Schicht Ettingen, Basel-Land, Schweiz
• ​ Ettingen
• ​ ab 01. Januar 2027
• ​ Schichtarbeit: 2 Schichten von Montag bis Freitag
• ​ unbefristet

Was dich erwartet Für unseren pharmazeutischen Herstellbetrieb suchen wir eine erfahrene Führungspersönlichkeit mit fundierter Erfahrung in der industriellen Produktion.
• Führung und Entwicklung eines 12 bis 15-köpfigen Teams inkl. administrativer Aufgaben (Durchführung von Mitarbeitergesprächen, Erstellung Schichtplan, Urlaubsplanung, Anwesenheits- und Absenzkontrolle)

• Unterstützung in diversen Projekten sowie bei der kontinuierlichen Weiterentwicklung der Produktion

Um diese Rolle erfolgreich zu meistern, suchen wir nach folgenden Qualifikationen:
• Abschluss im industriellen Bereich mit entsprechender Weiterbildung

• Systematische Arbeitsweise (Störungsbehebung, Produktion, Projektarbeit)
• Eigenverantwortlichkeit und ein hohes Qualitätsbewusstsein
• Sehr gutes praktisches und theoretisches Verständnis für Produktionsprozesse und Produktionsanlagen

descriptionByLocale.en:
CordenPharma is one of the leading Contract Development and Manufacturing Organizations (CDMO) and develops and produces pharmaceutical active ingredients, pharmaceuticals and related packaging services on behalf of its customers as a full-service service provider. The group employs around 3,000 people. Our network in Europe and the USA offers flexible and specialized solutions for six technology platforms: Peptides, Lipids & Carbohydrates, Injectables, Highly Potent & Oncology, Small Molecules and Oligonucleotides. We strive for excellence in supporting this network and are committed to providing the highest quality products for the benefit of patients. Our People Vision: We strive for excellence. We share our passion. Together, we make a difference in patients’ lives. Group Manager Production (m/f/d) 2-layer Ettingen, Basel-Land, Switzerland
• Ettingen
• from 1 January 2027
• Shift work: 2 shifts from Monday to Friday
• Perpetual

For our pharmaceutical manufacturing company, we are looking for an experienced leader with profound experience in industrial production.
• Leadership and development of a 12 to 15-member team including administrative tasks (conduct of employee meetings, preparation of shift plan, holiday planning, presence and absence control)
• Responsibility for the timely and qualitatively correct GMP-compliant execution of production orders
• Ensuring and controlling compliance with safety, quality, OE and environmental standards
• Close cooperation with neighbouring areas
• Support in various projects as well as in the continuous development of production

To successfully master this role, we are looking for the following qualifications:
• Industrial degree with appropriate training
• At least 5 years of management experience (professional and disciplinary) in industrial production, preferably in the pharmaceutical, food or chemical industry
• Systematic operation (impairment, production, project work)
• Personal responsibility and a high quality awareness
• Very good practical and theoretical understanding of production processes and production facilities
• Strong team skills
• very good knowledge of German in word and writing (min. C1)
• Knowledge of MS Office and SAP, TrackWise and PAS-X benefits

What we offer you Kantine KTG / NBU Premiums are 100% covered by us Above average pension fund services / 70% of the contributions are covered by us Paid breaks free parking

• Kaufmännische oder technische Grundausbildung, idealerweise ergänzt durch eine Weiterbildung im Einkauf, Supply Chain Management oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich
• Mehrjährige Erfahrung im operativen Einkauf, vorzugsweise in der Chemie-, Pharma- oder Life-Science-Industrie
• Kenntnisse im GMP-regulierten Umfeld oder in qualitätsrelevanten Beschaffungsprozessen sind von Vorteil
• Erfahrung in Change-, Projekt- oder Verbesserungsinitiativen, insbesondere in den Bereichen Prozessstandardisierung, Lieferantenkonsolidierung, Compliance oder Kostenoptimierung

• Kommunikationsstärke, Verhandlungsgeschick und überzeugendes Auftreten im Umgang mit Lieferanten, Global Procurement und internen Fachbereichen
• Teamorientierte Einkaufspersönlichkeit mit hoher Serviceorientierung, Business-Partner-Mentalität und Bereitschaft, Verantwortung innerhalb der Einkaufsorganisation zu übernehmen
• Kommerzielles Urteilsvermögen, datenbasierte Entscheidungsfindung und die Fähigkeit, globale Einkaufsstrategien in lokale Massnahmen umzusetzen

The group employs around 3,500 people. Our network in Europe, Asia and the US offers flexible and specialized solutions across six technology platforms: Peptides, Lipids & Carbohydrates, Injectables, Highly Potent & Oncology, Small Molecules and Oligonucleotides. We strive for excellence in supporting this network and are committed to delivering the highest quality products for the benefit of patients. Our People Vision: We strive for excellence. • Liestal
• immediately or by agreement
• ​ 80 - 100%

Your exciting task area
• Self-responsible handling of operational purchasing processes in the ERP system – from demand recording to ordering to timely delivery
• Obtaining, comparing and evaluating offers taking into account price, quality, delivery capability and regulatory requirements
• Active monitoring of delivery dates, tracking of open orders and proactive coordination with internal suppliers and suppliers
• Procurement of raw materials, chemicals, laboratory and consumables in the pharmaceutical and quality-relevant environment
• Interface management between purchasing, quality assurance, production, laboratory, finance and suppliers to ensure smooth procurement processes
• Service-oriented advice to internal customers on prices, delivery times, sources of supply and procurement options
• Coordination and follow-up of relevant supplier documentation such as specifications, analysis certificates, BSE/TSE documents and other GMP relevant evidence
• Support for change control processes and purchase-relevant projects to ensure documented and quality-compliant changes
• Maintenance, harmonisation and continuous improvement of processes and purchasing master data
• Support of the Head of Procurement in strategic purchasing initiatives (interface between Liestal and global purchasing)

Your profile
• Commercial or technical basic training, ideally supplemented by further training in purchasing, supply chain management or a comparable area
• Several years of experience in operational purchasing, preferably in the chemical, pharmaceutical or life science industry
• Knowledge in the GMP-regulated environment or in quality-relevant procurement processes is an advantage
• Experience in change, project or improvement initiatives, in particular in the areas of process standardization, supplier consolidation, compliance or cost optimization
• Very good knowledge of German and good knowledge of English in word and writing
• Secure handling of ERP systems as well as very good user knowledge in MS Office
• Communication strength, negotiation skills and convincing behavior in dealing with suppliers, global procurement and internal specialist areas
• Team-oriented purchasing person with a high service orientation, business partner mentality and willingness to assume responsibility within the purchasing organization
• Commercial judgment, data-based decision-making and the ability to translate global purchasing strategies into local action

Attractive and performance-oriented compensation package An attractive workplace with a high level of responsibility Above-average pension benefits / 70% of the contributions are taken over by us Corden Pharma offers you interesting and versatile tasks in a highly motivated team. Through practice-oriented training, we help you quickly gain professional security in order to work independently with a high level of personal responsibility.

Your Tasks We are seeking a highly motivated and scientifically curious Innovation Scientist with a strong hands-on mentality to join our Solid-State Development team at Corden Pharma Switzerland. Reporting directly to the Team Leader Solid-State Development, you will contribute to innovative research projects, experimental investigations, and scientific publications in pharmaceutical solid-state development. The position offers a unique opportunity to combine scientific excellence with practical industrial application in a dynamic CDMO environment.
• Independently plan, execute, and evaluate scientific case studies related to pharmaceutical solid-state development
• Identify and propose innovative research topics in collaboration with internal stakeholders and commercial teams
• Conduct comprehensive literature reviews and develop scientifically sound experimental strategies
• Perform solid-state screening studies including polymorph, salt, co-crystal, hydrate, solvate, and crystallization investigations
• Design and execute crystallization, precipitation, and solid-state development studies from screening scale to laboratory scale
• Design and execute experiments to understand, control, and optimize crystallization processes and solid-state properties of pharmaceutical compounds
• Apply and interpret analytical techniques such as XRPD, DSC, TGA, DVS, Raman spectroscopy, FTIR, microscopy, and particle characterization methods
• Analyse and critically evaluate experimental data and draw scientifically sound conclusions
• Prepare technical reports, scientific presentations, and project updates for internal and external stakeholders
• Contribute to scientific publications, conference presentations, white papers, and other technical communications
• Collaborate closely with experts from Solid-State Development, Process Development, Analytical Development, and Manufacturing Science
• Support the development of innovative scientific approaches and new service offerings in solid-state development.

Your Profile
• PhD in Physical Chemistry, Solid-State Chemistry, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Materials Science, Chemical Engineering, Organic Chemistry, or a related scientific discipline
• Strong understanding of crystallization processes, thermodynamics, phase behaviour, and solid-state properties of pharmaceutical compounds
• Hands-on experience with solid-state characterization techniques such as XRPD, DSC, TGA, DVS, Raman spectroscopy, FTIR, or related methods
• Ability to critically evaluate scientific literature and translate findings into practical development strategies
• Strong interest in experimental laboratory work within an industrial research environment
• Experience in pharmaceutical development, process chemistry, or organic chemistry is advantageous
• Excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving skills
• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within multidisciplinary teams
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; German is advantageous.
